title: T0003 Neurostimulation outcome evidence in drug-resistant focal epilepsy: RNS, ANT-DBS, VNS, SEEG/model-guided stimulation
body:
SCOPE AND METHOD
Search: Europe PMC REST API (PubMed records, resultType=core) with title/author queries for RNS pivotal/long-term/real-world, SANTE and ANT-DBS long-term/registry, VNS E05/meta-analysis/registry, SEEG-guided and virtual-brain-twin stimulation; no date limit. 17 sources screened (stopping rule 25), 15 kept as EvidenceClaims A0002-A0016. All passages are exact substrings of the retrieved abstracts (snapshots attached to each artifact). ONLY ABSTRACTS WERE READ - no full texts - so denominators at late timepoints, responder definitions and AE tables are unverified. Numbers are author-reported; the one R1-computed figure (MORE ratio of medians) is flagged.

RNS (closed-loop responsive cortical stimulation) - family fam-RNS-NeuroPace-feasibility-pivotal-LTT (A0002, A0003, A0004 = ONE study family, 191 pivotal + feasibility patients, 256 total):
- Pivotal RCT n=191: blinded 12 wk -37.9% vs -17.3% sham, p=0.012 (A0002; <12 mo).
- Open label: median reduction 44% at 1 y, 53% at 2 y (A0003).
- LTT 9 y: median 75%, responder 73%, 35% >=90% reduction, 18.4% (47/256) >=1 y seizure-free (A0004; completer denominator unclear).
Independent RNS families: real-world retrospective 8-centre n=150, median 67% (1 y) / 74% last FU (mean 2.3 y), 18% clinically seizure-free (A0005); post-approval prospective n=324 (271 at 3 y), median 82% at 3 y, 41% >=90%, 22.0% >=12 mo seizure-free (A0006).

SEEG-guided RNS (closed-loop) - A0007: multicentre retrospective n=55 neocortical, median 66.7% at 1 y, 77.5% at mean 2.35 y, 18.2% seizure-free; proximity of leads to sEEG focus predicted 1-y outcome only in strong responders.

ANT-DBS - family fam-SANTE-ANT-DBS-trial (A0008, A0009, A0010 = ONE family, n=110):
- RCT: 29% greater reduction vs control (GEE, p=0.002); unadjusted medians 40.4% vs 14.5% at 3 mo; 2 y median 56%, responder 54%, 14 pts seizure-free >=6 mo (A0008).
- 1 y median 41% / responder 43%; 5 y median 69% / responder 68%; 16% seizure-free >=6 mo (A0009).
- 7 y median 75% (57 active at closure; heavy attrition) (A0010).
Independent: MORE registry n=170, 41% (69/170) responders at median 3.5 y (A0011) - intention-to-treat denominator, so lower than SANTE completer figures.

VNS - family fam-VNS-E05-trial (A0012, A0013 = ONE family): E05 RCT 3 mo mean -28% high vs -15% low, p=0.04 (A0012; <12 mo); 12-mo extension n=195: median 45%, 35% >50% reduction (A0013). Englot 2011 meta-analysis (74 studies, 3321 pts, mixed focal/generalized, adults+children): 51% average reduction after >1 y, ~50% responders, seizure freedom rare (A0014; overlaps E05). VNS Patient Outcome Registry n=5554: 63% responders and 8.2% seizure-free at 24-48 mo (A0015; mixed epilepsy types).

Model-guided stimulation - A0016: Wang et al. 2025 (Nat Comput Sci) virtual brain twins for stimulation is a diagnostic EZN-estimation framework; its abstract reports NO clinical seizure outcome after model-guided therapeutic stimulation. No clinical outcome study of model-guided therapeutic stimulation was found in this search -> need opened.

SYNTHESIS (descriptive, not a meta-analysis)
At >=12 months, median % seizure reduction: RNS 44-53% (RCT 1-2 y) rising to 75% (9 y) and 67-82% in real-world/post-approval cohorts; ANT-DBS 41-56% (1-2 y) rising to 69-75% (5-7 y), registry responder 41%; VNS ~45% median at 12 mo, ~50-63% responders in pooled/registry data. Seizure freedom is uncommon for all modalities and inconsistently defined (>=6 mo vs >=12 mo periods vs 'at last FU'): RNS 18-22% with >=12 mo freedom; SANTE 16% >=6 mo; VNS ~8%. Long-term gains in open-label phases are confounded by attrition, ASM changes and programming changes; only the short blinded phases are randomized (RNS and ANT-DBS sham-controlled; VNS active-controlled). Cross-modality comparisons are indirect (no head-to-head RCT found).

INDETERMINATE / TO VERIFY
- Late-timepoint denominators (Nair 2020 9 y, Salanova 2015/2021) - full text needed.
- Possible patient overlap between Razavi 2020, Sadeghzadeh 2026 and the RNS trials at shared centres - not reported in abstracts.
- VNS evidence (A0014, A0015) is not restricted to focal epilepsy; protocol population mismatch.
- A0002 and A0012 fail the >=12-month follow-up criterion; kept as RCT anchors and flagged.
